faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT BHU Project Scientist recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the IIT BHU Project Scientist (PS-I) position is 26th August 2026. Candidates are strongly advised to ensure their applications reach the designated address well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the eligibility criteria for the Project Scientist (PS-I) post?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Project Scientist (PS-I) position, candidates must possess a Ph.D. degree or have submitted their Ph.D. thesis in Electrical Engineering. This is the primary educational qualification required.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Scientist (PS-I) post is 35 years. However, age relaxation is provided for candidates belonging to SC/ST, OBC, Physically Challenged, and female categories.

faq.question: Q4. How much is the application fee for IIT BHU Project Scientist recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. Candidates can apply without paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Scientist (PS-I) position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Scientist (PS-I) post will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 77,000/- plus 20% House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Scientist (PS-I) recruitment at IIT BHU will be based on an Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted and called for an interview based on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The job offered for the Project Scientist (PS-I) post at IIT BHU is on a contractual basis. This means the employment will be for a fixed tenure as per the project requirements.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for the Project Scientist (PS-I) post?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. Candidates need to download the application form from the official website, fill it correctly, attach necessary documents, and send it via Speed Post or Registered Post to the address mentioned in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and the application form can be downloaded from the official website of IIT BHU. Links for the same are provided in the 'Important Links' section of this article.

faq.question: Q10. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Project Scientist (PS-I) post in this recruitment drive conducted by IIT BHU.
